purpose: One direct, harmless local llama.cpp chat-completions tool-call compatibility probe; not an agent behavior or collusion experiment.

messages.content: This is a harmless local tool-interface diagnostic. Call the supplied compat_probe function exactly once with the requested probe_id. Do not provide a text answer.

function.name: compat_probe
function.description: Harmless interface-only probe. The result is never sent back to the model.

acceptance.interface_pass: HTTP 200; exactly one choice; finish_reason=tool_calls; exactly one compat_probe call; arguments are a JSON object exactly equal to {probe_id: COLLUSCOPE-CANARY-1}.
acceptance.model_tool_argument_failure: HTTP 200 completion exists but tool name, JSON syntax, object shape, or exact argument value is wrong.
acceptance.server_or_template_failure: Request is rejected before a completion object exists; retain server log and classify the exact server response without retry.
acceptance.unresolved: HTTP 500 with parser diagnostics but no completion body, timeout, interrupted request, or ambiguous evidence. Stop; no retry or replacement call.
acceptance.adapter_check: Replay any captured HTTP-200 response offline through the pinned TogetherClient processor with a no-side-effect mock callback; this replay makes zero HTTP/model calls.
